name: Track
_about: Track HUD, generated by design/gen_hud.py: twelve shift lights across the top, the gear big on the left (red at the shift point) with SHIFT beside it, a G-meter on the right (the dot at the lateral and longitudinal g, a ring at the peak of the last 3 s) with the lateral g under it. Fitted (Nov 9 2026) to the HUD as BMW's own height-adjust frame shows it, x 120..680, y 100..380, and kept clear of the bottom-left x 120..350, y 235..380, where BMW draws its speed and speed-limit sign (and in Sport its rev band) over ours. To change it, copy this file into the app data folder layouts/ (scripts/deploy.sh); the app reloads it by itself. Widget types and tokens: see the header of hud.js.
